description: Canonical public source data and metadata for Pathologize computational-pathology projects.

owns: unaltered source assets selected for the registry
source, access, provenance, citation, and licence manifests
source patient, case, specimen, slide, study, series, and instance identities
excludes: derived tiles, embeddings, features, masks, and model outputs
train, validation, test, fold, or leakage-group assignments
private data, weights, annotations, configuration, thresholds, product knowledge, and unpublished results
